text: The responsivity R of a photodiode (photocurrent produced per unit optical power) is given by:
explanation: Each absorbed photon of energy ℏω yields at most one electron of charge e, scaled by quantum efficiency η, giving R = ηe/(ℏω) = ηeλ/(hc). Choices 1 and 2 are inverted (units of W/A), and k_B T (thermal energy) plays no role in the photon-to-electron conversion.
